short_description: GlobalProtect VPN shows Portal unreachable on home WiFi
description: User cannot connect to VPN from home. Error: Portal unreachable. Works fine from office.
resolution: Root cause was captive-portal WiFi blocking port 443. Advised user to open a browser, accept the WiFi captive portal terms, then reconnect GlobalProtect. Also restarted the PanGPS service. VPN connected successfully.
close_notes: Captive portal WiFi. Accept portal terms + restart PanGPS service.

short_description: Account locked after multiple failed logins
description: User locked out of SSO after entering wrong password several times. Needs urgent access.
resolution: Account was locked by the 5-attempt policy. Force-unlocked the account in Okta, issued a temporary 24-hour password, and asked the user to reset via https://sso.acme.com/reset. Confirmed login restored.
close_notes: Okta force-unlock + temp password + self-service reset.

short_description: Pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff after deploy
description: New deployment of billing-service pods keep restarting with CrashLoopBackOff.
resolution: The deployment referenced a ConfigMap key that did not exist, so the container exited on startup. Corrected the ConfigMap, re-applied the manifest, and pods became Ready. Recommended adding a readiness probe with a longer initialDelaySeconds.
close_notes: Missing ConfigMap key. Fixed ConfigMap + re-applied.
